mutants.name: accept invalid credentials
mutants.description: Password verification is skipped for known users (API and HTML login).

mutants.name: viewer can read drafts
mutants.description: The viewer role is added to the roles that may read DRAFT items.

mutants.name: editor can publish
mutants.description: The editor role is added to the roles that may publish.

mutants.name: state is mutated by a forbidden request
mutants.description: A viewer's forbidden POST /items inserts a row before answering 403.

mutants.name: invalid quantity is committed
mutants.description: Range validation and the database CHECK on quantity are both removed.

mutants.name: duplicate SKU overwrites the original
mutants.description: INSERT becomes INSERT OR REPLACE, so a duplicate create silently replaces the row.

mutants.name: publish reports success but is never committed
mutants.description: publish_item no longer commits: the API/UI answer PUBLISHED while the database keeps DRAFT.

mutants.name: adapter alters literal values (unsafe literal handling)
mutants.description: Database.insert_item strips apostrophes from values - the naive 'fix' for the 2023 string-interpolation bug.

mutants.name: cross-test contamination (shared database)
mutants.description: The db_path fixture reuses one shared database file and never removes it, so tests see each other's data.

mutants.name: logout does not invalidate the session
mutants.description: DELETE /api/v1/session clears the cookie but leaves the server-side session row.

mutants.name: published item can be edited
mutants.description: The 409 item_published rule and the DRAFT-only guard of the UPDATE are removed.

mutants.name: update of a missing item creates a phantom row
mutants.description: PATCH on an unknown SKU inserts a new draft instead of answering 404.

mutants.name: UI shows a stale state after publish
mutants.description: The item detail page always renders the state DRAFT although API and database say PUBLISHED.

first_failing_assertion.message: AssertionError: Locator expected to have text 'PUBLISHED'

mutants.name: adapter builds an unescaped SQLite URI (KQA-001)
mutants.description: Database opens file:<path> escaping only '?', so '#' and '%' in a file name select a different database.

mutants.name: observer builds an unescaped SQLite URI (KQA-001)
mutants.description: The independent Observer interpolates the raw path into the URI again.

mutants.name: SKU validation accepts a trailing newline (KQA-002)
mutants.description: The SKU pattern is anchored with ^...$ and used with match(), which lets 'SYN-X\n' through (API and path check).

mutants.name: database no longer bounds quantity above (KQA-002)
mutants.description: The catalog_items CHECK drops the 1,000,000 upper bound, so the schema permits what the contract forbids.

mutants.name: database no longer checks the SKU format (KQA-002)
mutants.description: The SKU character-set and leading-hyphen CHECK is removed, so rows such as 'x' or 'SYN-X<newline>' can be stored.

mutants.name: typed client skips item-list verification (KQA-003)
mutants.description: list_items returns body['items'] without checking the envelope, element types, required fields or count.

mutants.name: malformed error envelope is reported as valid (KQA-003)
mutants.description: ApiHttpError always claims envelope_valid=True, hiding that the server error body was unreadable.

mutants.name: report generator accepts an empty mutation list (KQA-004)
mutants.description: check_mutation_evidence no longer rejects mutants=[] nor missing expected mutant ids.

mutants.name: package verifier ignores manifest sizes (KQA-005)
mutants.description: verify_inventory compares SHA-256 only; a forged size in the manifest is accepted.

first_failing_assertion.message: AssertionError: assert 'size mismatch: README.md (manifest 999, actual 5)' in []

mutants.name: package verifier accepts duplicate ZIP entries (KQA-005)
mutants.description: check_zip_entries no longer flags duplicate or ambiguous names, so the last duplicate wins silently.

mutants.name: separate-process evidence accepts a skipped test (v1.0.2)
mutants.description: The per-layer 'pass all tests, no skips' rule is disabled, so a skipped test hides behind an unchanged grand total.

mutants.name: malformed list field crashes the evidence checker (v1.0.2)
mutants.description: _str_list stops validating its input, so an integer or duplicate-laden list reaches the iteration code.

first_failing_assertion.message: AssertionError: ['no test of layer framework in the JUnit evidence', 'no test of layer database in the JUnit evidence', 'no test of la...ht in the JUnit evidence', 'no test of layer e2e in the JUnit evidence', 'no browser screenshots in the evidence', ...]

mutants.name: negative counts are accepted as evidence (v1.0.2)
mutants.description: _is_count no longer rejects negative integers.

first_failing_assertion.message: AssertionError: assert None is not None
